bullets.text: Assisted with 40+ bedside central line insertions in a 24-bed medical ICU
Cared for 2 ventilated or post-surgical ICU patients per shift
Assisted with the unit's switch to barcode medication scanning across 3 shifts
Precepted 5 new graduate nurses through their 12-week ICU orientation
Recorded vital signs for 12 residents per shift in the electronic health record
Helped 12 residents a shift with bathing, meals and walking

coverage.note: assisted with central line insertions, never led them
assisted with the barcode scanning switch, did not lead it
precepted 5 new graduates; no charge experience
